fpvdrone.betaflight.title: BetaFlight Configurator
item.fpvdrone.lytui_drone.usage: Place on the ground. Fuel it first with a fuel can (right-click). Right-click the drone to open the map planner — lay down the flight route, set each point's altitude and the terminal action (loiter/dive/destroy), then Send. Then walk into it from directly behind, pushing it ~5 blocks down the runway, to fire up the engine and take off. Sneak + attack to pick it back up.
item.fpvdrone.fuel_can.usage: A 20-litre petrol can. One full can fuels exactly one combustion-engine drone (FP-1 / «Лютый»). Right-click a grounded drone (or a ramp-loaded FP-1) to fill its tank. The drone burns fuel in flight and glides down as a dud when it runs dry — right-click the wreck with an empty can to drain whatever fuel is left. Sneak + right-click in the air to pour the can out (empty it).
item.fpvdrone.fp1_drone.usage: Install it on a launch ramp (right-click the ramp with it). Fuel the loaded ramp with a fuel can, then right-click the ramp with the BetaFlight programmer to open the map planner — set the flight route, altitude and terminal action (loiter/dive/destroy), then press Launch. It cannot be placed or flown by hand.
item.fpvdrone.lancet51_drone.usage: Install it on a launch ramp (right-click the ramp with it). Fuel the loaded ramp with a fuel can, then right-click the ramp with the BetaFlight programmer to open the map planner — set the flight route, altitude and terminal action (loiter/dive/destroy), then press Launch. It cannot be placed or flown by hand.
item.fpvdrone.orlan10_drone.usage: Install it on a launch ramp (right-click the ramp with it). Fuel the loaded ramp with a fuel can, then right-click the ramp with the BetaFlight programmer to open the map planner — set the flight route and altitude, then press Launch. Unarmed reconnaissance UAV: the autopilot always flies the assigned route, so it can never be hand-flown or crashed on purpose. Enter first-person view to pan/tilt the camera gimbal, zoom, and lock a target with the ZALA reticle — purely for observation.
item.fpvdrone.ramp.usage: Place it on top of a block as a launch pad. Right-click with an FP-1 drone to install it, then right-click with a fuel can to fill its tank. Right-click the ramp with the BetaFlight programmer to open the map planner and launch. Right-click with an empty hand to take the drone back (its fuel comes with it); attack the ramp to pick it up.

item.fpvdrone.fpv_goggles.usage: Right-click a drone to link. Equip while the drone has a battery installed. Shift+Scroll to switch video channels. Press [%s] to take the goggles off and switch to the controller view.
item.fpvdrone.drone.usage: Place on solid ground. Right-click with the remote and goggles to link them, then insert a battery. Right-click with an RPG-7 Round or RGD-5 Grenade to attach a payload.
item.fpvdrone.battery.usage: Right-click a drone to install it. To remove it, hold Shift and right-click the drone.
item.fpvdrone.remote_control.usage: Right-click the drone to link it. Hold it in hand to fly.
item.fpvdrone.rpg7.usage: Right-click a compatible drone to attach it. Detonates on impact.
item.fpvdrone.rgd5.usage: Right-click a compatible drone to attach it. Detonates on impact.
item.fpvdrone.tm62.usage: Right-click the "Can Opener" vest to load this anti-tank mine into it.
item.fpvdrone.opener.usage: Wear it as a chestplate. Right-click it with a TM-62 mine to arm it.
item.fpvdrone.dji_controller.usage: Right-click the Mavic 3 Pro to link it. Hold it in hand to fly; press [%s] to open or close the camera view.
item.fpvdrone.betaflight.usage: Field mission planner. Right-click a loaded launch ramp (or a grounded munition) to open the route-planning map.
item.fpvdrone.40mm_explosive.usage: Right-click the Mavic 3 Pro to load it into the bomb bay. Released over the target, it detonates on impact.
item.fpvdrone.70mm_rocket.usage: Right-click an installed rocket-pod tube on a compatible drone to load it. Fired forward — falls back to gravity + drag after the launch impulse and detonates on impact.
item.fpvdrone.rocket_pod_mount.usage: Right-click a compatible drone to install a rocket pod (one-way upgrade). Then load 70mm NAR Rockets into its tubes.

fpvdrone.config.header:
Edit values and restart the game to apply.
Works on both client and dedicated server.
Server values override client settings for all players.
fpvdrone.config.section.signalNote:
(When simpleRange > 0, distance values are auto-scaled
 and the manual values below are ignored.)
fpvdrone.config.simpleRange:
Quick range setup. Set to your desired max range in blocks
and ALL distance parameters below will auto-scale.
Set to 0 to disable and configure manually.
fpvdrone.config.signalRangeMultiplier:
Global multiplier on EVERY drone's link range (and its video-freeze
distance). 1.0 = use each drone's data as-is; 2.0 = double all ranges; 0.5 = half.
The antenna characteristics themselves are per-drone in the data "signal" block.
fpvdrone.config.maxRange:
Maximum flight range in blocks. Signal drops to zero beyond this
distance and the drone enters failsafe.
fpvdrone.config.freezeStartDistance:
Distance (blocks) at which the video feed starts stuttering.
Below this distance the picture is perfectly clean.
fpvdrone.config.obstaclePenaltyMultiplie:
Signal penalty strength for blocks between pilot and drone.
0.0 = obstacles have no effect. 1.0 = default. 2.0 = twice as strong.
fpvdrone.config.groundProximityPenaltyMa:
Maximum signal penalty (%) applied when flying low to the ground
at long range. Simulates ground-level RF attenuation. 0 = disabled.
fpvdrone.config.groundProximityDistanceS:
Distance (blocks) at which the ground-proximity penalty starts.
Closer than this threshold = no penalty.
fpvdrone.config.groundProximityHeightThr:
Height above ground (blocks) below which the drone is considered
low-flying for the purpose of the ground-proximity penalty.
fpvdrone.config.heightBonusPerBlock:
Signal bonus per block of altitude above the height baseline.
Higher altitude = better signal. 0 = no bonus.
fpvdrone.config.heightBaseline:
Y-level above which the altitude bonus starts to apply.
Flying below this level gives no bonus.
fpvdrone.config.signalSmoothing:
How quickly signal strength responds to changes.
Low values = slow, cinematic transitions. High = near-instant.
fpvdrone.config.zeroSignalFramesForDisco:
Number of consecutive zero-signal frames before the failsafe
triggers. Higher = more tolerant of brief signal loss.
fpvdrone.config.freezeIntensity:
How aggressively the video stutters as signal degrades.
Higher = more freeze frames at range. 0 = no freeze effect.
fpvdrone.config.failsafeDescentRate:
Descent speed (blocks/tick) when the signal is lost.
The drone slowly drops until it lands or regains signal.
fpvdrone.config.failsafeHorizontalDampin:
Horizontal speed multiplier per tick during failsafe.
1.0 = no braking. 0.0 = instant horizontal stop.
fpvdrone.config.explosionBreaksBlocks:
Master switch for block-destroying explosions.
false = explosions never break blocks. true = they do, and the STRENGTH is
taken from each projectile/warhead's own "blockPower" in data (0.5 = weak, 1.0 = TNT, 2.0 = double).
fpvdrone.config.explosionBlastRadius: Radius (blocks) of the blast-wave damage pass.
fpvdrone.config.explosionBlastDamage: Peak blast-wave damage dealt at the edge of the kill zone.
fpvdrone.config.explosionKillZone:
Instant-kill radius (blocks). Entities inside this radius
die regardless of armor or distance.
fpvdrone.config.explosionOpensDoors:
When true, the blast forces all doors, trapdoors, and
fence gates in the blast radius into the OPEN state.
fpvdrone.config.shrapnelCount:
Number of shrapnel rays cast per explosion.
More rays = better hit detection through cover, but higher CPU cost.
fpvdrone.config.shrapnelLethalRange:
Inner radius (blocks) where shrapnel deals flat peak damage
before falling off with distance.
fpvdrone.config.shrapnelBaseDamage: Shrapnel peak base damage. Peak = base + scale * power.
fpvdrone.config.shrapnelScaleDamage: Shrapnel peak damage added per unit of explosion power.
fpvdrone.config.shrapnelDamageCap: Maximum (non-instant-kill) damage applied to any single entity.
fpvdrone.config.droneCollisionDamage:
When true, drones deal impact damage to entities
(mobs and players) on collision.
fpvdrone.config.droneObserverRange:
Entity tracking range for drones (blocks). Controls how far
observers can see drone movement and animations.
Server-side only — not synced to clients.
commands.fpvdrone.explosive.enabled: Drone/warhead explosions will now break blocks (server-wide).
commands.fpvdrone.explosive.disabled: Drone/warhead explosions will no longer break blocks (server-wide).
item.fpvdrone.hd_camera.usage: Right-click an FPV drone to fit it; Shift + right-click removes it (after the RPG and the battery). Lets your goggles show a clean feed (F6): no OSD, no video effects, no props. While the clean feed is on, the drone draws about 35% more current.
entity.fpvdrone.drone.hd_camera_already_: An HD Digital Camera is already fitted
entity.fpvdrone.drone.hd_camera_not_ther: The thermal drone has its own camera
fpvdrone.config.explosionBlockPower:
Block-destruction power. 0.0 = no blocks broken.
1.0 = equivalent to vanilla TNT. 2.0 = double strength.
fpvdrone.config.kamikazeExplosionPower:
Explosion power for kamikaze / RPG drone detonations.
Scales shrapnel radius and damage output.
fpvdrone.clean_feed.needs_hd_camera: Clean feed needs an HD Digital Camera on the drone
fpvdrone.status.turtle_on: Turtle mode: ON - motors reversed, use pitch/roll to flip
fpvdrone.status.turtle_disabled: Turtle mode is off on this server (config: turtleMode)
fpvdrone.config.turtleMode:
Crashed drones can stay upside down; flip them back with turtle mode
(Betaflight crash flip: toggle key, then pitch or roll). Off = drones
right themselves on the ground. Server setting, synced to clients.
item.fpvdrone.gps_module.usage: Right-click an FPV drone to fit it; Shift + right-click removes it (after the HD camera). Gives the quad GPS Rescue: the return-to-home key (P) flies it home and lands it, and when the signal is lost it flies home by itself instead of falling. Press P again to take back control.

fpvdrone.status.gps_rescue_active: GPS Rescue: flying home (P to cancel)
fpvdrone.status.gps_rescue_failsafe: Signal lost - GPS Rescue flying home
fpvdrone.config.windEnabled:
Wind pushes drones (with Weathery installed, its wind is used; otherwise
a built-in wind that rises in rain and thunder). Off = still air, as in 1.1.8.
Server setting, synced to clients.
fpvdrone.config.windStrength:
Wind strength multiplier (1 = about 1-5 m/s on a normal day, 8 m/s in a
Weathery high-wind spell).
fpvdrone.config.windSheltering: Walls, hills and trees upwind shelter drones from the wind.
